run_fuzz_test_llvm_backend: run the pytest fuzz test that generates random LLVM programs via llvm-stress and applies random optimization trajectories
test_fuzz_random_trajectory: test the LLVM backend by applying a random trajectory of length 1-10 to an llvm-stress generated benchmark
run_test_with_pytest: run the llvm_stress_fuzz_test.py module using pytest to fuzz test the CompilerGym LLVM environment
review_test_fuzz_function: review the test_fuzz function that resets an LlvmEnv with a random llvm-stress benchmark and applies random actions
summarize_llvm_stress_fuzz_test: summarize the fuzz test module that uses llvm-stress generated benchmarks to stress test the CompilerGym LLVM backend
